pageOf.1: the product (Cabineo 8, Cabineo 12, Cabineo 8 M6 and their black versions, the isometric with 33.8 / 16.5 / 10), the machines, Assembly panels 1 to 6, Technical information, Applications (minimum panel thicknesses), the strength table, the 'No dowel necessary' box
pageOf.2: Machining: four mountings (On the surface, Flush with the surface, Flush cover cap, HPL on the surface), each a section drawing and three machining options (Option 1 drill dia 15, Option 2 cutter >= dia 10, Option 3 cutter dia 12)

source.read: T78 F20, 11.10.2026: the text layer with pdftotext -layout and pypdf, both pages rendered at 400 dpi with pdftoppm and every drawing read at that scale; nothing fetched from the web
source.caveat: every number below is as the sheet prints it; a value that is null is NOT on the sheet and the sentence beside it says what is missing; a value inside a 'derived' object is arithmetic on printed numbers and says which; a 'reading' is what the drawing shows without a printed number

counterpartHole.depthNote: the sheet prints no depth for the 5 mm hole; it prints the screw's projection X beyond the board's end (variants.*.screwReachXMm: 8 / 12 / 8) and the counterpart panel's minimum thickness (variants.*.minPanelMm). 'D-5 mm', 'D-5.8 mm' and 'D-7.1 mm' on page 2 are NOT this hole's depth: each is the distance from the screw axis to the far face of the board that carries the connector (D is that board's thickness), printed in the pocket section
counterpartHole.axis: on the pocket's screw axis: 5 mm from the collar seat (mountings.*.axisFromCollarSeatMm); the collar seat is the face for On the surface and HPL, 0.8 below the face for Flush with the surface, 2.1 below the face for Flush cover cap (mountings.*.derived.axisFromSurfaceMm)
counterpartHole.position: in the FACE of the counterpart panel on the joint line, one hole per pocket, at the pocket's position along the joint (Assembly, panel 1 and panel 2: pockets along one board's end, matching holes in the other's face)
counterpartHole.drawing: every section drawing of page 2: 'dia 5 mm' on the counterpart panel (the hatched upright at the left), 'X' the screw's projection beyond the board's end

machining.consistency: a check, not a number: three dia 15 circles at 3.6 / 14.8 / 26 give a waist half-height of sqrt(7.5^2 - 5.6^2) = 5.0 (printed 5), a half-height at the board's end of sqrt(7.5^2 - 3.6^2) = 6.6 (printed 6.6), and meet a 12 mm channel 4.5 from each centre, at 8.1, 10.3, 19.3 and 21.5 (printed 8.1 + 2.2 and 19.3 + 2.2); the printed numbers agree with each other

cap.note: the sheet draws a cover cap (Assembly panels 5 and 6, and the Flush cover cap mounting with its 2.1 mm recess, 18.8 wide, 35.65 long) but prints no cap article number, colour or size; the owner supplies the cap article

owner.by: the owner, 11.10.2026 (CLAUDE.md T78 F20, THE INVERTED SIDE); decided, not proposed
owner.noEdgeDrilling: Cabineo drills NO panel edge; the sheet's own claim 'no edge drilling' (page 1) says the same
owner.pocket: milled into the FACE of the horizontal board (top, bottom, fixed shelf) at its end, the channel open to the end (the sheet's x = 0)

pocketCutFrom.top: the OUTSIDE face, from above (under the worktop)
pocketCutFrom.bottom: the OUTSIDE face, from below (in the plinth void)

owner.ownerWords: ciecie nie od srodka korpusu tylko do zewnatrz
owner.counterpartHole: the screw passes through the board's end into a 5 mm hole drilled into the FACE of the side, from the inside (the face every hinge plate and shelf pin already lives on), on the joint line, at each pocket's position
owner.consequence: with the pocket cut from the OUTSIDE face, the side's 5 mm hole sits mountings.<chosen>.derived.axisFromSurfaceMm from the board's OUTSIDE face (On the surface 5, Flush 5.8, Flush cover cap 7.1): for a top, that far below its top face; for a bottom, that far above its underside; for a fixed shelf, that far above its underside
owner.export: the top, the bottom and a fixed shelf with Cabineo pockets carry machinedFace 'outside'; their DXF is drawn as seen from that face, x' = W - x, through the SAME reflection T76 built for the decorative fronts' FRONT files (cnc/frontOperations.js, frontX = partWidth - backX), never a second one; the operations JSON and the part label print 'OUTSIDE FACE UP'
owner.setOut: profile.joints.cabineo holds the set-out (endOffsetMm 50 from each end, then every pitchMm 250, T78 proposed, never fewer than two); the sheet's limits that bound it are spacing.edgeMinMm 20 and spacing.maxMm 300 above
owner.skinCheck: the T76 skin check (MIN_SKIN 3 mm between opposing blind cuts) runs between every outside-face pocket and every inside-face drilling of the same board; a clash is refused in words, naming the board and the two cuts

profileChoices.note: numbers and choices live in src/engine/profile.js, not here: profile.joints.cabineo.mounting (T78 proposed 'flushCap') and profile.joints.cabineo.machining (T78 proposed 'cutter12', the owner's Biesse mills; he decides), the variant (8 or 12, chosen in company defaults as joints.system 'cabineo8' or 'cabineo12'), pitchMm 250 and endOffsetMm 50 (T78 proposed), and the confirmed: false gate that blocks the CNC export until the owner confirms these numbers

notes: Articles: the sheet prints no connector, insert or cap article; CLAUDE.md's 186310 for Cabineo 8 is not on page 1 (or page 2). Written as null.

Corner joints: CLAUDE.md expects 'corner joints from 12 / 14'; the sheet prints, per variant, the counterpart panel (the one that takes the screw) >= 9 (Cabineo 8), >= 13 (Cabineo 12), >= 14 (Cabineo 8 M6) and the board that carries the connector >= 12 in every case. The sheet's numbers are written.
Centre wall: as CLAUDE.md expects, Cabineo 8 from 16 and Cabineo 12 from 24; Cabineo 8 M6 is 14 to 16 (a range, with the 12.3 insert).

Counterpart hole depth: CLAUDE.md reads 'its depth as the sheet gives it relative to the panel thickness D'; 'D-5 mm' (and D-5.8, D-7.1) is the screw axis to the far face of the board that carries the connector, not the hole's depth. The hole's depth is not printed: null.

Option 2: CLAUDE.md's '26 x 6.6 outline' is not how the sheet dimensions it: 26 is the end to the third lobe centre and 6.6 the half-height where the outline meets the board's end; the outline's full length is not printed for On the surface or Flush with the surface (a full dia 15 third lobe would end at 26 + 7.5); for the cap recess the sheet prints 35.65.
Option 3: CLAUDE.md's '26 x 6' is likewise 26 to the third centre and 6 the half-height of the straight 12 mm channel; 8.1 and 19.3 are where the two straight sections start, each 2.2 long.

Collar and cap recesses: Flush with the surface prints 0.8 (the collar recess) and 0.7 (at the pocket floor); Flush cover cap prints 2.1 (the cap recess) and 0.95 (at the floor); HPL prints 1 at the floor. The floor dimensions carry no caption on the sheet.
HPL on the surface is captioned for Cabineo 8 M6 only and prints its own option numbers (dia 15.2, 3.5, 14.7, 25.9, 9.1, 20.3, 5.2, 6.6, 6.8, 8.2, 19.3, 1.8).
Screw lengths are not printed, only the projection X beyond the board's end.
The strength table is for 19 mm panels only and every value carries the sheet's asterisk (disclaimer on lamello.com).
The sheet is the operating instructions; Lamello's CAD files the T75 README asked for are still not in the repo. Nothing here is taken from a CAD file.
No number in this file is invented: null where the sheet is silent.
